title: plugin-manifest — IS marketplace-tier v2 contract (projection-mirrored composition)
description: The v2 plugin-manifest authoring contract (the `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` manifest shape). PURE COMPOSITION — zero authored fields of its own. It is the allOf of three v2 layers: (1) the upstream base, REGENERATED from the captured projection per DR-062 (documented fields only — the full 23-field documented surface incl. the 11 component-path fields and $schema/defaultEnabled/displayName; upstream requiredness [name] only; upstream wire forms incl. the commands string|array union); (2) the three v2 universal folds by $ref to the v2 marketplace-tier foundation; (3) the v2 IS overlay (the seven carried IS promotions + the relocated commands array narrowing + the relocated structural name encoding + the relocated `metadata` extension). v2 has ZERO $ref into the frozen v1 family (copy-then-regenerate); the v1 plugin-manifest composition stays the PUBLISHED contract with the narrower base. The Zod validator AND this inline $comment effective-required manifest are GENERATED by scripts/codegen-authoring.ts from the base+overlay JSON Schemas — never hand-typed. Lifecycle SHIPPED-INTERNAL. Adjudication: DR-062 (plugin-manifest rows C1 = 058 #1/#3, C2 = 058 #2, C3 = 058 #4/#5).
